يعتقلان (form VIII)
# يَعْتَقِلَانِ (yaʕtaqilāni) /jaʕ.ta.qi.laː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# يُعْتَقَلَانِ (yuʕtaqalāni) /juʕ.ta.qa.laː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
